Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.logging.correlation

Class ActionSessionManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.logging.correlation.ActionSessionManager
@Component public class ActionSessionManager extends Object
Manages action sessions for correlated logging. Uses SLF4J MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) to add session and sequence information to all logs.

This allows tracking of related actions across a workflow, making it easier to debug complex automation scenarios and understand action sequences.

Actions are automatically tracked - no need to call nextAction() manually: 

 sessionManager.startSession("Login Workflow");
 action.find(usernameField);     // Automatically tracked as seq:001
 action.type(usernameField, username);  // Automatically tracked as seq:002
 action.click(submitButton);     // Automatically tracked as seq:003
 sessionManager.endSession();

    • startSession

      public void startSession(String taskName)
      Start a new action session with a descriptive name. All subsequent logs will include the session ID for correlation.
      Parameters:
      taskName - A descriptive name for the task being performed

    • nextAction

      @Deprecated public void nextAction()
      Deprecated.
      Since actions are now tracked automatically, this method is no longer needed. It's kept for backward compatibility but will be called automatically.
      Increment and set the sequence number for the next action. This helps track the order of actions within a session.

    • incrementSequence

      public int incrementSequence()

      Returns:
      The new sequence number

      public int getCurrentSequence()

    • endSession

      public void endSession()
      End the current session and clear MDC context. Logs a summary of the session including total actions performed.

    • executeWithSession

      task - The task to execute
